column1: # Questions of the quiz put in Russian, for the retrieval test of Search by meaning (tools/embed/bench.py).
# A line: the question's id (data/quiz/), a tab, the question in Russian.  The answer is still the paragraph
# of the English text the quiz judges it by: a Russian question finds it across the languages by meaning,
# and by words through the translations.  Paper 1's 27 that the text answers (ids 823-850), and 73 of the
# edition's, taken by random.Random(20261124).sample() of the rest in the order of their ids.
# The book's own terms are the Foundation's translation's (Всеобщий Отец, Настройщик Мышления, Древние Дней),
# everything else plain Russian.  Drafted on 2026-11-24, for Tigran to check; not shown to readers.
